title: meeting-recorder
subHeroDesc: Record conversations directly inside KeilHQ, transcribe discussions automatically with speaker diarization, and turn decisions into tasks in one click.

sections.title: Floating audio visualizer and smart transcription
sections.desc: Record meetings with a draggable Picture-in-Picture widget that survives app navigation and minimizes to the sidebar. Auto-transcribe conversations with multi-speaker diarization and secure S3 storage.

gridItems.title: Picture-in-Picture Widget
gridItems.desc: A floating PIP widget that is fully draggable and survives app navigation, letting you record uninterrupted as you navigate tasks and files.

gridItems.title: Voice Pattern Visualizers
gridItems.desc: Choose from custom visualization themes (Aura, Wave, Radial, or Bar) animating your voice pattern in real-time.

gridItems.title: Multi-Speaker Diarization
gridItems.desc: Splits transcripts by speaker (e.g. Speaker 1, Speaker 2) to easily track who agreed to what, avoiding giant walls of text.

gridItems.title: Auto-Language Detection
gridItems.desc: Processes audio with automatic language detection, supporting 23 regional Indian languages via Sarvam AI, with secure S3 storage.

sections.title: AI-generated summaries and actionable intelligence
sections.desc: Extract bulleted summaries and export them directly to Motion or Notion in one click. Review AI action proposals backed by exact transcript quotes, modifying details before approval.

gridItems.title: Bulleted AI Summaries
gridItems.desc: Receive instant, clean summaries of your meetings organized by discussion topic instead of reviewing raw transcripts.

gridItems.title: 1-Click Workspace Export
gridItems.desc: Export your meeting summaries and full transcripts directly into editable pages inside Motion or connected Notion workspaces.

gridItems.title: Evidentiary Action Proposals
gridItems.desc: Extract commitments to propose tasks, CRM edits, pipeline updates, and invoices, complete with the triggering quote.

gridItems.title: Review & Approval Flow
gridItems.desc: Review suggestions on interactive approval cards. Modify assignees, adjust parameters, and click Approve to create items instantly.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ brings voice recordings and summaries directly into your projects, making transcripts contextual.
checklistTitle: Never lose what was decided in your last meeting
checklistDesc: Stop taking manual minutes. Let the AI recorder handle documentation and actions for you.
checklistItems: Picture-in-Picture Widget: Draggable, floating PIP recorder window that survives app navigation and minimizes to the sidebar.,
Audio visualizer patterns: Aura, Wave, Radial, or Bar voice pattern animations responding to live audio input.,
Speaker Diarization: Automatically splits full transcripts by speaker (Speaker 1, Speaker 2) for clear conversation mapping.,
Auto-Language Detection: Supports 23 regional Indian languages via Sarvam AI, with secure AWS S3 cloud audio storage.,
AI Action Proposals: Extract commitments to propose new tasks, task updates, CRM edits, pipeline updates, and invoice drafts with evidence verification.
